create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed coefficients and U blocks for a given lmax value
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D matrix coefficients for angular momentum levels from lmin to lmax
compute_wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices from Ra and Rb real and imaginary parts using torch.compile compatible arithmetic
transform_wigner_d_to_real: transform complex Wigner D matrices to real spherical harmonics basis using precomputed U blocks
decompose_quaternion_to_ra_rb: decompose quaternions in wxyz convention into real and imaginary parts of Ra and Rb
